headline: 13 dead after tourist plane crashes in Peru
summary: The aircraft was carrying foreign tourists heading to visit the world-famous Nazca Lines.
details: A tourist aircraft carrying foreign nationals crashed in Peru, resulting in the death of all 13 people on board.
The plane was en route to the world-famous Nazca Lines, a popular archaeological site known for its massive geoglyphs.
Emergency services responded to the scene, where firefighters were seen battling blazes at the wreckage.
Authorities are investigating the cause of the crash that claimed every life on the aircraft.
caption:
13 people killed as a tourist plane crashes in Peru.

A tourist aircraft carrying foreign nationals crashed in Peru, resulting in the death of all 13 people on board.

The plane was en route to the world-famous Nazca Lines, a popular archaeological site known for its massive geoglyphs.

Emergency services responded to the scene, where firefighters were seen battling blazes at the wreckage.

Authorities are investigating the cause of the crash that claimed every life on the aircraft.

headline: 14,384 primary teachers to join on Oct 1
summary: The Ministry of Primary and Mass Education has brought forward the joining date for thousands of newly recruited assistant teachers.
details: The Ministry of Primary and Mass Education has announced that 14,384 newly selected assistant teachers will join their duties on October 1.
Selected candidates are required to report to their respective District Primary Education Offices on the specified date.
According to a notice signed by Deputy Secretary Rajib Kumar Sarkar, appointment letters will be sent to the selected candidates in a timely manner.
Following their joining, the teachers will be assigned to specific schools and subsequently sent for professional training to enhance their skills.
The joining date was initially considered for October 29, but was finalized as October 1 after an emergency virtual meeting held by the ministry.
The recruitment process began with a written MCQ exam on January 9 this year across 61 districts, excluding the three hill districts.
Out of the candidates, 69,265 were called for oral exams, and the final results were published on February 8 by the ministry.
caption:

Out of the candidates, 69,265 were called for oral exams, and the final results were published on February 8 by the ministry.
